runs.why: The statements concerning the 1% room rent limit and the proportionate deduction rule are supported by passage [1], and the numerical figures are supported by the tool result for sub_limit.
Every statement regarding the room rent limit, percentage, amount, and proportionate deduction mechanism is fully supported by passage [1] and the corresponding tool results.
The statement about the policy excluding non-medical items including gloves is supported by passage [1].
The statement correctly quotes the exclusion for non-medical items from passage [1], which is in force on the date of loss.
The statements regarding Nil Depreciation cover and the standard 50% depreciation rate for plastic parts are fully supported by passages [1] and [2] respectively.
The statement that the policy was in force is supported by the tool result, and the statements regarding the 5-year age limit, claim count, and plastic parts are supported by passage [1].
Every statement regarding the decision timelines and endorsement amendments is supported by passages [1] and [2].
All statements about the decision timelines are supported by passage [1], which is in force on the date of loss.
The text states the policy limit is INR 10,00,000, which contradicts the policy limit tool result showing INR 5,00,000.

the text asserts that intimation after 37 days fails the 30-day requirement (applying the rule to facts it does not fit, as intimation was 37 days while the requirement is 30 days), which is unsupported by passage [1] because [1] merely sets the 30-day requirement without the text itself applying it to the claim facts.
The text correctly points the adjuster to clause 6A in Endorsement 1 [1] regarding No Claim Bonus protection without making an ungrounded assertion about its outcome.
every statement regarding the policy wording is directly supported by passage [1], which is in force on the date of loss.
Every statement regarding policy wording, limits, and endorsements is fully supported by the policy passages and tool results.
The text makes no claims about policy wording, limits, periods, conditions, or exclusions.
Every statement regarding policy wording is supported by passage [7].

Every statement regarding policy terms, exclusions, and tool figures is supported by passage [1] or the tool results, and the text correctly points to the applicable exclusion without misapplying its facts or rules.
The statements about coverage and limits are supported by policy passage [1] and the tool results confirming the policy is in force and retrieving the applicable limits.
Every statement made about the policy wording, limits, and deductibles is fully supported by the policy passages and tool results.
The text makes no statements about policy wording or endorsements.
The statement accurately reflects the hospitalisation benefit provisions set out in passage [1].
Every statement regarding the policy wording is directly supported by passage [1].
every statement concerning the policy wording is supported by passage [1].

The statement regarding the general 20% co-payment rule for ages 61 and above is supported by passage [1], and the amendment changing the age threshold to 66 years and the co-payment percentage to 10% is supported by passage [2], both of which are in force on the date of loss.
the 10% co-payment and the age threshold of 66 years are supported by passage [2], which is in force on the date of loss.
The statement concerning the 30-day reimbursement submission window is supported by passage [1], which is in force on the date of loss.
The statement that the reimbursement submission window is 30 days from discharge under Endorsement 2 is fully supported by passage [2].
Every statement made about the policy wording, limits, and exclusions is supported by the corresponding policy passages or tool results.
All statements concerning policy limits, deductibles, and coverage provisions are fully supported by the policy passages and tool results.
Every stated limit, sub-limit, and policy condition is fully supported by the corresponding policy passages [1] and [2] and the tool results in force on the date of loss.
The statements regarding the 50% tyre sub-limit and the INR 1,500 compulsory deductible are supported by passages [1] and [3] respectively.
Every statement regarding what the policy wording provides is fully supported by passage [1].
The statements about the 20% co-payment and the age threshold of 61 and above are fully supported by passage [1].
Every statement regarding the co-payment age threshold and percentages is supported by passage [2] and the tool results, which are in force on the date of loss.
The statements regarding the co-payment age threshold are directly supported by passage [2] and the tool results.
The statement that the reimbursement submission window remains 15 days relies on [1], but [2], effective prior to the date of loss, amends the window to 30 days.

the text states that a 20% co-payment applies for insured persons aged 61 and above, but Endorsement [2] (which is in force on the date of loss) amends this to a 10% co-payment for persons aged 66 and above.
The text falsely claims that the policy specifies a 10% co-payment for insured persons aged 66 and above, which is not supported by any passage or tool result.

The statement claims the room rent cap is INR 10,000 per day, which directly contradicts the tool result and passage [1] showing the limit is 1% of the sum insured, equating to INR 5,000 per day for a sum insured of INR 500,000.
The text states the newborn sub-limit is INR 5,00,000, which contradicts passage [1] limiting it to INR 2,00,000.
Every statement regarding settlement timelines and investigation decision windows accurately reflects either the base policy [2] or Endorsement 3 [1] which is in force on the date of loss.

The statement that a second claim halves the bonus and only a third claim reverts it to nil contradicts passage [1], which states that a second or subsequent claim results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil.

the statement that day care procedures cover any procedure completed within 48 hours and that Annexure A need not be checked contradicts passage [1], which specifies procedures requiring less than 24 hours and listed in Annexure A.
The text states that the policy excludes prescribed medicines, which is not supported by passage [1] or any other passage.

The statement that the policy wording contains no limit on tyre replacement contradicts passage [1], which expressly provides for a 50% limit on tyre replacement when the vehicle is damaged at the same time.
The text is ungrounded because it introduces a "0.03% threshold" for blood alcohol that appears in no policy passage and no tool result.
The self-inflicted injury exclusion is asserted to apply to a fall at home, which is a rule applied to facts it does not fit.
The statements regarding the 1% room rent limit, proportionate deduction, and the INR 5,000 limit based on the sum insured are fully supported by passage [1] and the tool results.
The 30-day submission window statement is supported by passage [2], which is in force on the date of loss.
All statements regarding the 15-day decision timeline and the 30-day investigation decision timeline under Endorsement 3 are fully supported by passage [1], which is in force on the date of loss.
The statement that a 20% co-payment applies to insured persons aged 61 and above is fully supported by passage [1].
